scientific_integrity: Closed-form generator proof with symbolic and independent path-simulation checks; original temporal-comparison claim isolated from preexisting stationary moment formulas.
scientific_limitations: Athermal isotropic three-dimensional confinement only; physically realizable angular eigenvalue pairs only; no claim about full positional laws, arbitrary higher-time observables, or independent scientific validation. The original papers already derive separate moment hierarchies.
title: Quadrupole-blind radial-energy memory separates matched run-and-tumble and active Brownian traps
